blueos.description: Docker-based companion OS with extension store. Full vehicle management, video, and third-party extensions.
blueos.name: BlueOS

dronebridgeEspnow.description: Connectionless encrypted telemetry up to 1km range. Requires ESP32 on both air and ground side.
dronebridgeEspnow.feature2: Up to 1km range with ext. antenna
dronebridgeEspnow.name: DroneBridge ESP-NOW Long Range

dronebridgeWifi.description: Replace SiK radio with WiFi telemetry. Connect QGroundControl, Mission Planner, or ArduDeck wirelessly.
dronebridgeWifi.name: DroneBridge WiFi Telemetry

esp32MavlinkBridge.description: Lightweight serial-to-WiFi bridge. Minimal firmware for simple telemetry forwarding over UDP.
esp32MavlinkBridge.name: MAVLink WiFi Bridge (Minimal)

esp32XbeeNtrip.description: NTRIP server, client and caster on an ESP32. Puts a base receiver on the network, or pulls corrections down on the vehicle, with no laptop in the field.
esp32XbeeNtrip.feature1: NTRIP server, client and caster modes
esp32XbeeNtrip.feature5: Same firmware for base or vehicle side
esp32XbeeNtrip.name: RTK Corrections Bridge

jetsonCvCompanion.description: GPU-accelerated object detection and tracking with YOLO. Real-time obstacle avoidance and target following.
jetsonCvCompanion.name: Computer Vision Companion
jetsonCvCompanion.requirement1: NVIDIA Jetson Nano or Orin Nano

openhdAir.description: Digital FPV system: HD video + telemetry + RC over WiFi broadcast. Up to 50km range.
openhdAir.name: OpenHD Air Unit

piMavproxyNtrip.description: Vehicle side: pulls corrections from a caster and injects them as GPS_RTCM_DATA straight into the flight controller. Nothing on the ground has to stay connected.
piMavproxyNtrip.feature3: Sends vehicle position upstream for VRS mountpoints
piMavproxyNtrip.feature4: Works on LTE or a phone hotspot
piMavproxyNtrip.name: RTK Injector
piMavproxyNtrip.requirement1: Raspberry Pi with LTE or WiFi
piMavproxyNtrip.requirement2: Serial or USB link to the FC

piMavsdkAutonomy.description: Python environment with MAVSDK for onboard autonomous missions. Run scripts without a GCS link.
piMavsdkAutonomy.name: Autonomous Mission Runner

piStr2strBase.description: Base side: reads RTCM3 off the receiver and pushes it to an NTRIP caster. Headless, reconnects on its own, no GUI anywhere.
piStr2strBase.feature2: Feeds rtk2go or a private caster
piStr2strBase.name: RTK Base Streamer
piStr2strBase.requirement1: Raspberry Pi with network or LTE
piStr2strBase.requirement2: Base receiver on USB or 3.3V UART

piTelemetryBridge.description: MAVLink router + WiFi AP. Connects ground stations wirelessly without a telemetry radio.
piTelemetryBridge.name: Telemetry Bridge
piTelemetryBridge.requirement3: UART or USB connection to FC

piVideoTelemetry.description: Camera streaming with GStreamer + MAVLink routing. Low-latency H.264 video over WiFi.
piVideoTelemetry.name: Video + Telemetry

rpanionServer.description: Full-featured companion with web UI. Telemetry routing, video streaming, NTRIP, and network management.
rpanionServer.name: Rpanion Server
